svg.text: World 1 | element Star | status review | hero: Tail
height 3.50 studs | 76 blocks | 854 triangles | bevel 0.125 x 2 | 1 stud = 68 px
Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `halo` (Legendary eye), 56 x 26 px at 32 a stud, 11 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Star. VFX: touches the ground (Legendary): Effects.luau's four white stars orbiting
the Body (radius 0.6, a lap in 6 s), a violet trail (B79CFF) from the Tail, cream twinkles
(FFF6D8) streaming back off the Tail at 6 a second, a violet light (8F6BFF) on the Body pulsing
every 3.4 s, violet puffs (9D7BFF) round the Body at 4 a second, and the flourish every 12 s, a
burst of 24 white twinkles, with the tier's gold ground ring and orbit in its pale gold accent
(FFE9A8); a Hover idle of 0.45 studs over 3.2 s. On the model the stars, the sparkle crosses
and the tail's tip are cream glow cells. The rig adds the motion and the flourish: the tail
swishes, the top puff breathes, the shoulder stars bob and turn, the ringed planet circles, the
fallen star twinkles, and every 12 s it hops and turns once round with its tail swishing, the
stars leaping and the planet popping
